name: arxiv_rlad_math_reasoning_benchmark_hints
description: A collection of mathematics reasoning problems derived from arXiv papers with associated hints. The benchmark measures an LLM's ability to perform multi-step mathematical reasoning and produce correct, often structured, solutions given minimal prompting. It is intended to evaluate chain-of-thought capability and rigorous problem solving rather than surface-level recall.
reputation: A niche research dataset for evaluating advanced mathematical reasoning in LLMs; limited adoption compared to larger public reasoning benchmarks.
